tokens.build: Compile registered brand tokens with the shipped compiler. Use it when you need fresh CSS and JSON; use brand_create to create a brand or brand_apply to change its source. Returns inline CSS variables, CSS and JSON plus artifact paths, hashes and sizes. apply:true builds in isolated artifact storage; omission previews the artifacts without writing. Requested brand/theme selects the inline scope; full CSS includes every registered scope. Source and shipped runtime files stay unchanged. Full schema: oods://schemas/tokens_build.input.json.
structuredData.fetch: Fetch live registry datasets, archived token/export data, or captured-run artifacts. Use it when you need complete datasets; catalog_list selects components and object_registry reads definitions. Returns data with provenance, version and cache metadata. Full remains the default; detail:summary gives section counts and meta.next for inline pages; follow meta.next until absent. dataset selects registry/export mode; version pins an archived export and listVersions lists dates. kind plus runPath selects captured artifacts, while derived_analysis reads an analysis directory via runPath; version/listVersions are refused in kind mode. includeInternal exposes hidden objects, and ifNoneMatch checks the canonical payload ETag. Full schema: oods://schemas/structured_data_fetch.input.json.
brand.apply: Preview or apply changes to an existing brand's canonical token source. Use it when editing a brand; use brand_create to create one. Returns validation, changed slots, before/after hashes and build evidence. delta is required and supports aliases or add/remove/replace patches. apply defaults to a dry run that writes nothing. apply:true validates first, then writes source and rebuilds; build failure leaves source edits in place. For shipped brands in the portable runtime, apply emits a review kit and reports source/build steps as skipped. User brands rebuild in their own folder. Full schema: oods://schemas/brand_apply.input.json.
brand.intake: Create a brand or stage a local token intake draft. Use it when adding a brand; use brand_read for templates, validation, derivation and draft review, or brand_apply to edit a brand. Returns a staged draft or created brand with build results. apply needs draftId and accept:true. create accepts filled documents or a recipe, validates all themes, refuses replacement and removes a brand whose build fails. Full schema: oods://schemas/brand_create.input.json.
catalog.list: List components from the live component-contract registry. Use it when selecting components; structured_data_fetch returns complete datasets. Returns component names, categories, readiness labels and availableCategories; detail controls added tags, contexts, regions, traits and evidence. includeInternal exposes hidden registry objects. Filtered calls without detail default to full pages of 10; nextPage continues. Explicit detail preserves unpaged output. Readiness evidence retains the build it measured and does not certify a new composition. Full schema: oods://schemas/catalog_list.input.json.
code.generate: Generate React/Vue file sets or a standalone static HTML document from a validated UiSchema. Use it when a schema already exists; use design_compose instead to choose a layout or pipeline_run to compose, validate, render and generate together. Returns versioned artifacts, exact dependencies, required domain handlers and validationReceipt. Supply schema or schemaRef before its 30-minute expiry. profile selects draft/build/release; build performs static checks, while release verifies supplied evidence without rerunning it. options.output selects component/application; options.payloadMode:file returns file references, as does oversized output unless inline. Domain actions require consumer handlers. React and Vue shadcn mappings support components, screen apps and workflow apps. Full schema: oods://schemas/code_generate.input.json.
design.compose: Compose an object screen or workflow into a UiSchema. Use it when choosing layout and components; use pipeline_run instead for the complete generation flow or code_generate when you already have a schema. Returns schema, a 30-minute process-local schemaRef and durable compositionId/version lineage. Prefer explicit object and context over keyword-based intent. preferences controls region/field order and sample seed; compositionId appends a version, while options.transient records none. Save schemas with schema_store to reuse across sessions. Selected nodes snapshot component mappings; composition does not generate or run an app. Full schema: oods://schemas/design_compose.input.json.
design.preview: Render, compare, edit or accept a running React/Vue composition. Use it when reviewing generated behavior; use design_versions to inspect lineage without starting a host, or fidelity_preview for static drawings. Returns preview URLs, editable fields and measured or unmeasured evidence. Supply compositionId/version or object/context. Edits create versions; compare generates missing artifacts. accept records the generated version and a snapshot of its measurements as accepted, preserving prior acceptances. Full schema: oods://schemas/design_preview.input.json.
pipeline: Run composition, validation, rendering and code generation in one call. Use it when starting from an object/context or intent and needing generated output; use design_compose instead to inspect layout first or code_generate for an existing schema. Returns step results, schemaRef with expiry, versioned artifacts, dependencies and validationReceipt. options controls validation/render skipping and optional static accessibility checks; save persists the schema beyond its process-local 30-minute reference. Generation validation forwards draft/build/release without downgrade. Release verifies supplied evidence without rerunning it; unresolved accessibility pairs stay unmeasured. Oversized output goes to files unless options.payloadMode is inline. Calls may write composition and saved-schema records. Full schema: oods://schemas/pipeline_run.input.json.
health: Read server readiness, live registry/store counts and retained proof summaries. Use it when checking availability and built brand/theme scopes; use object_registry for definitions or registry_snapshot for mappings. Returns status, server uptime, registry counts, token scopes and productReality evidence. status:ok means sources were readable; retained proofs identify their measured build and do not automatically certify this one. includeChangelog and sinceVersion filter the reported DSL changelog. tokens.defaultScope is configured metadata rather than an observed consumer scope; missing scope data is unavailable. Full schema: oods://schemas/health_check.input.json.
registry.snapshot: Read mappings together with active traits and objects in one snapshot. Use it when reading combined registry data; object_registry reads one definition and object_register saves one. Returns mappings, traits, objects, generatedAt, ETag and registry loader issues. Defaults to a summary; detail full adds schemas. includeInternal exposes hidden objects; otherwise hiddenInternal counts omitted entries. Team definitions and shadowing are reported from live sources. This read-only call writes no snapshot file. Historical mapping fields remain stored data and do not imply current capabilities. Full schema: oods://schemas/registry_snapshot.input.json.
viz.render: Render one data-bound chart from rows or a structured data operand. Use it when creating chart output; use artifact_certify instead to grade a normalized chart or dashboard_render for multiple panels and KPIs. Returns Vega-Lite or ECharts specs, chart identities and requested SVG/accessibility output. pattern uses bundled data and forbids explicit data/encoding/presentation overrides. Otherwise use chartType plus encodings, omit chartType for recommendations, or supply structured intent. ECharts-primary families require their matching hierarchy/network/geo operand. brand/theme controls pixels; output.includeNormalizedSpec returns the IR required by artifact_certify. Temporal rendering uses UTC. For native ECharts after JSON transport, restore currency and precision with @oods/foundry/echarts.js. Charts take inline data only; URLs, images and links in the input are refused. Full schema: oods://schemas/viz_render.input.json.
dashboard.render: Render coordinated charts and KPIs from shared datasets and panel definitions. Use it when composing a dashboard; use viz_render instead for one chart or artifact_certify to grade each returned normalized chart. Returns layout, per-panel specs/hashes, computed KPI values, accessibility data and a reusable specRef. output.includeNormalizedSpec includes panel IR; output.html adds rendered HTML. brand/theme controls emitted pixels; selection and crossFilter apply caller-supplied filtering. resolveMeasures defaults true for governed measure references. output.contrastScan is a four-pair token preflight, not whole-document certification. Chord and flow_map are excluded from dashboards. Panels take inline data only. Full schema: oods://schemas/dashboard_render.input.json.
artifact.certify: Grade a normalized chart's accessibility equivalence, determinism, contrast and accuracy. Use it when checking the IR returned by viz_render or dashboard_render; use viz_render instead to create chart output and dashboard_render to compose panels. Returns coverage, conformant, findings and four pillar verdicts. Pass spec alone for Cartesian charts; ECharts-primary charts need the same matching data branch used for rendering. Spec-only ECharts remains uncertified. brand/theme must match rendering; high contrast reports forced-colors exemption without a numeric contrast grade. A certified chart may still be nonconformant; inspect all verdicts. This read-only check does not repair charts and never fetches a URL. Full schema: oods://schemas/artifact_certify.input.json.
fidelity.preview: Draw object relationships or compositions at four fidelity levels. Use it when reviewing static structure or appearance; use design_preview instead to run generated React/Vue behavior. Returns SVG or HTML with fidelity-specific structure and provenance. fidelityKind selects boxes-arrows, wireframe, review or branded-mockup. Supply exactly one object, objects set, schema/schemaRef, fixture or legacy manifest; object/context composes a screen. Object diagrams show declared relationships; schema diagrams show containment. Wireframe/review show component bindings and recorded confidence, and branded mockups use static sample data. options.brandOverlay/theme selects built tokens. These drawings do not certify usability or referential integrity. Full schema: oods://schemas/fidelity_preview.input.json.
map: Write component substitutions or stage an intake draft. Use it when connecting React/Vue exports, shadcn source or built Storybook files; use component_map_read to list, resolve or review drafts. Returns staged evidence or write outcomes. apply with draftId requires accepted ids and writes adapters and mappings atomically. create takes one entry, mappings or mappingsPath; create and report-based apply preview unless apply:true. update and delete always write. Full schema: oods://schemas/component_map.input.json.
schema: Save or delete a named composition schema. Use it when retaining a UiSchema across sessions; use schema_read to list or load saved schemas. Returns the saved metadata or deletion result. save takes schemaRef, overwrites that name and increments its version; only the latest is loadable. Both actions write immediately. Full schema: oods://schemas/schema_store.input.json.
object: Read object and trait definitions or validate YAML without saving. Use it when exploring shapes or checking a definition; use object_register to save one or object_import to draft from a schema file. Returns definitions, composed traits, validation findings or cache reload status. includeInternal reveals hidden objects; reload clears only process caches. Full schema: oods://schemas/object_registry.input.json.
repl: Validate a UiSchema or render static HTML and fragments. Use it when checking schema or patch contracts; use design_preview for a running app or schema_store to save. Returns diagnostics or rendered output. action selects validate/render; mode selects full/patch. apply:true enables rendering, without saving a schema. Render includes token CSS unless output.compact; oversized output or output.payloadMode:file writes only reply payloads. brand and scope options affect documents; ignored fragment options are diagnosed. Full schema: oods://schemas/schema_render.input.json.
object.import: Draft objects from local OpenAPI, JSON Schema, Postgres SQL, Prisma, dbt, OData or GraphQL files, then apply accepted proposals. Use it when importing a schema; use object_import_read to review a staged object. Returns importId, staged files, proposal counts and re-import differences, or batch registration results. draft takes source.path or source.content; apply requires explicit objects and proposal ids. overwrite replaces team objects; confirmShipped names approved shipped replacements. No network fetch or code execution. Full schema: oods://schemas/object_import.input.json.
a11y.scan: Grade built token contrast and optional static screen accessibility. Use it when checking component token pairs and HTML structure; use artifact_certify for chart pillars or design_preview for measured browser evidence. Checks button states per intent, text at 4.5:1, and icons/progress/meter marks at 3:1. Returns measured pairs, document findings and explicit unmeasured cases. Without a schema it checks every built brand/theme; a UiSchema scopes pairs to its components and adds static HTML checks. Dynamic/inherited/system paints remain unmeasured. Browser layout, keyboard/focus and screen-reader behavior are not tested. apply:true writes the report, transcript and bundle index; omission writes nothing. Full schema: oods://schemas/a11y_scan.input.json.
object.write: Register an object or trait from reviewed YAML. Use it when saving a definition; use object_registry to list, inspect or validate without writing. Returns the saved definition and registry result. overwrite replaces your own definition. Team objects may shadow shipped objects; traits cannot reuse shipped names. Relationships must name valid targets and fields. Full schema: oods://schemas/object_register.input.json.
schema.read: Read saved composition schemas. Use it when listing saved work or loading a named schema; use schema_store to save or delete one. Returns metadata or the schema with a new process-local schemaRef, valid for 30 minutes. Tool input schemas are separate MCP resources. Full schema: oods://schemas/schema_read.input.json.
map.read: Read component substitutions and staged intake evidence. Use it when listing mappings, resolving an external component or reviewing a draftId; use component_map to stage or apply changes. Returns entries, matches or draft evidence including proposed adapters and unmatched elements. Reads local stores without generating adapters or changing project files. Full schema: oods://schemas/component_map_read.input.json.
brand.read: Read brand templates, validate documents, derive recipes or inspect staged drafts. Use it when preparing a brand without saving; use brand_create to stage or create it. Returns complete template slots, validation findings, a recipe with provenance and gaps, or draft evidence. derive takes exactly one of tokens, css or absolute cssPath. Template replies use compact JSON so all themes fit inline. Full schema: oods://schemas/brand_read.input.json.
object.import.read: Read one staged object import. Use it when reviewing YAML, graded proposals and unmapped elements before acceptance; use object_import to draft or apply. Returns the named object, proposals and differences from its registered definition. Supply importId and the exact object name. Reading never rewrites the staged report. Full schema: oods://schemas/object_import_read.input.json.
design.versions: Read a composition's versions and accepted version. Use it when inspecting saved lineage; use design_preview to render, edit, compare or accept. Returns version metadata, latest and acceptance summary. Supply compositionId. Starts no preview host and returns no running URL. Full schema: oods://schemas/design_versions.input.json.
